claim_boundary: Surrogate of a SCREENING dataset; not physical-orbit evidence; not a performance model. The targets are orbit-integration outcome counts on L1a screening fields; the surrogate reproduces those counts' probabilities within a declared accuracy inside a declared interpolation scope. Nothing here validates the orbit model, the field model, the mirror picture or any thruster figure of merit. The v1-vs-v2 comparison compares two surrogates of the same screening dataset; it says nothing about physics.
